background_story: Pinky was a mischievous rabbit with a knack for escaping the most secure enclosures. Dubbed 'Houdini' by his owners, he had a talent for slipping through tiny openings and vanishing into thin air. One day, Pinky managed to squeeze through a gap in his cage and made a break for freedom. He led his owners on a wild chase, darting under furniture and leaping over obstacles. Just when they thought they had him cornered, Pinky would disappear, only to reappear in a completely unexpected location. His Houdini-like escapes became the stuff of legend, earning him a special place in the hearts of everyone who knew him. Despite his love of freedom, Pinky always returned to his cozy cage, where he would snuggle up and await his next opportunity to escape.
